SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(IF(app_type = 1, 1, 0)) AS cert_apply_count, SUM(IF(app_type = 2, 1, 0)) AS cert_renew_count, SUM(IF(app_type = 3, 1, 0)) AS cert_change_count, SUM(IF(app_type = 4, 1, 0)) AS info_change_count FROM biz_application where deleted = b'0'
and app_status = 1

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(IF(license_device_name = 'X线正电子发射断层扫描仪', 1, 0)), 0) AS petCtScanner, IFNULL(SUM(IF(license_device_name = '伽玛射线立体定向放射治疗系统', 1, 0)), 0) AS gammaRayStereotacticRtSystem, IFNULL(SUM(IF(license_device_name = '直线加速器', 1, 0)), 0) AS linearAccelerator, IFNULL(SUM(IF(license_device_name = '内窥镜手术器械控制系统', 1, 0)), 0) AS endoscopicSurgicalSystem, IFNULL(SUM(IF(license_device_name = '1.5T及以上磁共振成像系统', 1, 0)), 0) AS mriSystem1_5tPlus, IFNULL(SUM(IF(license_device_name = '64排及以上X线计算机断层扫描仪', 1, 0)), 0) AS ctScanner64SlicePlus, IFNULL(SUM(IF(license_device_name = '首次配置的大型医疗器械', 1, 0)), 0) AS firstTimeLargeMedicalDevice, IFNULL(SUM(IF(license_device_name = '高端放射治疗类设备', 1, 0)), 0) AS highEndRtEquipment, IFNULL(SUM(IF(license_device_name = '重离子质子放射治疗系统', 1, 0)), 0) AS heavyIonProtonRtSystem FROM biz_class_a_equipment WHERE deleted = b'0'
AND YEAR(create_time) = #{year, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
